dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Bays and Anchorages on the east coast of Borneo
dct_alternative_sm: Bays and Anchorages on the east coast of Borneo
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys between 1898 and 1923.
Relief shown by form lines and spot heights; depths by soundings.
Includes Conversion Table, buoy legend, Tidal Information, abbreviations and authority text.
Shows low water areas, waterways, ports.

Maps: Buayabuaya and Manimbora Anchorages, Natural Scale 1:202,173 -- Kaniungan Islands, Natural Scale 1:171,069 -- Sangkulirang Bay, Natural Scale 1:155,084 -- Balik Papan Bay, Natural Scale 1:100,176 -- Balik Papan Road, Natural Scale 1:30,282 -- Klumpang Bay, Natural Scale 1:99,726.
